selected.title: Freight moves. The observer stays.
selected.texas_link: Customer freight movement along the Dallas to Houston corridor in Texas.

movement.object: Volvo VNL Autonomous powered by Waabi Driver for Warp

selected.why_today: The October 5th customer-operation launch is a fresh dated application in the current reporting window, not covered by the recent films.
selected.consequence: Warp customer freight now moves directly to third-party facilities on this autonomous Texas lane, with an observer aboard.
selected.application_change: The Volvo and Waabi partnership begins its first Warp customer operation, applying the truck to a reported customer freight task.
selected.counter_image: The driver seat remains occupied, and additional routes are planned rather than already operating.
selected.earned_take: Customer freight is the operational change; autonomous control does not mean an empty cab.

sources.access_note: Original source full web read and same corporate Cision text; not independent corroboration

agency.next_step: The companies plan to use lane experience to prepare additional routes.
agency.who_can_act: Volvo, Waabi and Warp operate the customer lane; the release announces no public participation deadline.

filmability.viewer_question: What changes when an autonomous truck starts carrying a customers freight?
filmability.opening_action: A recognizable enclosed freight truck moves with an occupied cab, rather than a driverless empty-cab reveal.
filmability.mechanism: Waabi Driver is integrated into Volvo VNL Autonomous; the reported application is direct freight movement between third-party facilities, not a disclosed algorithm.
filmability.human_consequence: Warp customers goods now move on this autonomous Dallas–Houston lane; an observer still accompanies hauls.
filmability.source_limit: Corporate self-report. No independent performance audit, mileage, truck count, cargo identity, measured on-time improvement, safety result or observer duties reported.
three_key_images: Fresh sculpted generic enclosed tractor-trailer carrying sealed customer freight
Same truck crossing an illustrative Dallas–Houston lane to a recognizable warehouse endpoint
Closer occupied-cab inset held alongside trailer stopped at facility

asset_leads.relevant_image: Authentic corporate still of white VNL tractor with roof autonomy hardware and enclosed semitrailer on paved multi-lane road.
asset_leads.what_it_proves: Reference equipment appearance; does not independently establish route, delivery, cargo contents or cab occupancy.
asset_leads.inspection: Viewed exact 1024x579 JPEG; front three-quarter truck, closed white box trailer, roof sensor bars, moving surrounding road blur. Cab interior unclear.
asset_leads.rights_basis: Corporate publication and high-resolution media link establish provenance only. No reuse license fetched; not admitted for published film.
asset_leads.decision: reference only; generate fresh disclosed illustration

action_support.pictured_action: An explicitly illustrated generic enclosed tractor-trailer travels on a paved freight lane, with a visible seated observer indication.
action_support.scope_fit: Director-bound source-backed proposal; existing action catalog contains no trucking action. A proposed moving truck needs builder implementation and independent proof, not researcher approval.
action_support.relationship: An explicitly illustrated generic enclosed tractor-trailer travels on a paved freight lane, with a visible seated observer indication. Disclosed conceptual freight relationship, not an actual observed delivery or route geometry.

action_support.pictured_action: The same truck maintains identity while moving between Dallas and Houston facility endpoints; small parcel distinctions may explain LTL abstractly but no actual shipment payload.
action_support.scope_fit: Disclosed explanatory lane, not a literal route geometry, private UI, observed load sequence or inferred autonomous control trace.
action_support.relationship: The same truck maintains identity while moving between Dallas and Houston facility endpoints; small parcel distinctions may explain LTL abstractly but no actual shipment payload. Disclosed conceptual freight relationship, not an actual observed delivery or route geometry.

action_support.pictured_action: The same sealed trailer reaches and stops at an illustrative third-party facility while observer remains visibly seated; keep achieved freight operation separate from planned expansion.
action_support.scope_fit: Source supports direct facilities and occupied cab. Arrival is explanatory completion of the reported task, not a documented individual delivery; no unloading procedure, measured gains or empty cab.
action_support.relationship: The same sealed trailer reaches and stops at an illustrative third-party facility while observer remains visibly seated; keep achieved freight operation separate from planned expansion. Disclosed conceptual freight relationship, not an actual observed delivery or route geometry.

filmability.strongest_useful_image: Truck and trailer physically reach a facility; maintaining truck identity connects autonomous travel to actual customer operation. The occupied-cab return corrects the likely empty-cab inference.
filmability.missing_picture: No truthful picture exists for claimed reliability improvement, accident avoidance or actual customer cargo contents; omit those spoken claims.
filmability.likely_false_inference: Autonomous means nobody aboard. Establish the observer with the first autonomous claim and retain it in the ending.
filmability.report_order: Mechanism-led: identify truck and load, date and operator, carry same trailer to facility, expose occupied cab, end on actual customer operation and unmeasured performance.
filmability.alternative_approach: Observed documentary cannot show a delivery from a single press photo with no licensed footage; a static excerpt would bury the physical task.

visual_stakes.affected_person: Warp customers, shippers and the onboard observer
visual_stakes.physical_subject: Enclosed freight truck and third-party facility
visual_stakes.visible_change: Same truck carries sealed freight along lane and reaches facility
visual_stakes.consequence: Customer freight operation has started, with observer still aboard
visual_stakes.opening_question: What changes when an autonomous truck starts carrying a customers freight?
visual_stakes.answer: The freight service changes; the seat remains occupied and performance gains are unmeasured
visual_stakes.asset_fit: Two fresh relevant ImageGen images shared across exactly two complete treatments: sculpted truck hero plus purposeful dock/observer environment. No private UI or prior artwork.

rejected.title: West Texas A&M funded research feedlot
rejected.reason: The grant is real and refers to AI-powered approaches, but the release supplies no named performed AI action or result. Animating current feeding decisions would invent the mechanism.
